name: Voxel Mesh Rendering with Texture Atlas & Per-Vertex Lighting
definition: Renders voxel chunks as triangle meshes using a horizontal texture atlas for block faces, applying per-vertex ambient occlusion (AO) and smooth light in the fragment shader with directional lighting.
summary: Voxel Mesh Rendering with Texture Atlas and Per-Vertex Lighting renders voxel chunks as triangle meshes using a shared horizontal texture atlas to reduce bind calls and applies per-vertex ambient occlusion with directional lighting.
